## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (a headless window test for anything in the window)
- [ ] Anything a person can do has a `torrz` command ([how](../docs/development.md#add-a-command))
- [ ] `docs/cli.md` is updated if a command's arguments or output changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased
- [ ] A screenshot is attached if something looks different (`torrz-app --snap`)
